data.title: Choose the sentence that uses the word correctly.

sections.title: animal
sections.question: animal
sections.summary: a living creature that can move and feel, such as a dog, cat, or horse

senses.definition: a living creature that can move and feel, not a plant or a human being
examples: A dog is a popular animal that many people keep as a pet.
They saw many different animals at the safari park.

answers.answer: A dog is a popular animal that many families keep as a pet.
She drinks an animal every morning before going to school.
He planted an animal in his garden to grow food for the winter.
She drove her animal to work every day because the office was very far away.

sections.title: beach
sections.question: beach
sections.summary: a flat area of sand or small stones next to the sea or a lake

senses.definition: a flat area of sand or small stones next to the sea or a lake, where people sit and relax
examples: They spent the whole day at the beach swimming and playing in the sand.
She loves going to the beach in summer to sunbathe and swim in the sea.

answers.answer: They spent the whole day at the beach swimming and building sandcastles.
She cooks all her meals at the beach because it has the best kitchen in town.
He goes to the beach every morning to buy fresh vegetables for dinner.
She uses the beach to travel quickly between cities for her work.

sections.title: bird
sections.question: bird
sections.summary: an animal with wings and feathers that usually can fly

senses.definition: an animal with wings, feathers, and a beak that usually can fly
examples: She saw a beautiful bird sitting in the tree outside her window.
Many birds fly south to warmer countries in winter.

answers.answer: She saw a beautiful bird sitting in the tree outside her bedroom window.
He drank a cold bird before going to bed each evening.
She drove her bird to work every morning through the city traffic.
He planted a bird in the garden to grow food for the family.

sections.title: climate
sections.question: climate
sections.summary: the typical weather conditions in a particular area or country

senses.definition: the typical weather conditions in a particular region or country
examples: The climate in Spain is warm and sunny for most of the year.
She moved to a warmer climate because she hated cold winters.

answers.answer: The climate in Spain is warm and sunny for most of the year.
She drank the climate before going out for her morning walk.
He cooked the climate in the oven to make the house feel warmer.
She wore the climate on her head to protect herself from the rain.

sections.title: flower
sections.question: flower
sections.summary: the colourful part of a plant, or a plant that produces colourful blooms

senses.definition: the colourful part of a plant that attracts insects, or the plant itself
examples: She picked some flowers from the garden to put in a vase on the table.
The park is full of beautiful flowers in the spring.

answers.answer: She picked some flowers from the garden to put in a vase on the table.
He drank a big cup of flowers before going to bed each night.
She drove her flowers to work because they were too heavy to carry.
He parked his flowers outside the office every morning before starting work.

sections.title: forest
sections.question: forest
sections.summary: a large area of land covered with many trees

senses.definition: a large area of land covered with a thick growth of trees
examples: They went for a long walk through the forest on Sunday afternoon.
The forest is home to many animals, including deer and foxes.

answers.answer: They went for a long walk through the forest and saw many wild animals.
She cooks her meals in the forest every day because it has the best kitchen.
He takes the forest to work every morning instead of the bus.
She drinks the forest every morning to stay fit and healthy.

sections.title: mountain
sections.question: mountain
sections.summary: a very high area of land with steep sides

senses.definition: a very high area of land with steep sides, higher than a hill
examples: They climbed to the top of the mountain and had a beautiful view of the valley.
She loves skiing in the mountains every winter.

answers.answer: They climbed to the top of the mountain and saw a beautiful view of the valley.
She drinks a mountain every morning before going to school.
He cooks a mountain for the family every Sunday evening for dinner.
She drove her mountain to the office every morning through the city.

sections.title: nature
sections.question: nature
sections.summary: the physical world including plants, animals, land, and weather

senses.definition: all the plants, animals, land, and weather in the world that has not been made or changed by people
examples: She loves nature and often goes for walks in the countryside.
He took many beautiful photographs of nature on his holiday.

answers.answer: She loves nature and often goes for long walks in the countryside.
He drank nature every morning to give him more energy for the day.
She cooked nature in the kitchen for the whole family on Sunday.
He drives nature to work every day because it is faster than walking.

sections.title: pollution
sections.question: pollution
sections.summary: harmful substances that damage the air, water, or land

senses.definition: harmful chemicals or other substances that damage the air, water, or land
examples: Air pollution in the city is getting worse because of all the cars.
The government is trying to reduce pollution by encouraging people to use public transport.

answers.answer: Air pollution in the city is getting worse because of all the cars.
She drinks pollution every morning because it gives her energy.
He eats pollution for dinner because it is very good for his health.
She grows pollution in her garden because it looks very beautiful.

sections.title: recycling
sections.question: recycling
sections.summary: the process of treating used materials so they can be used again

senses.definition: the process of collecting and treating used materials such as glass, paper, and plastic so that they can be used again
examples: She does recycling every week by putting glass, paper, and plastic in separate bins.
Recycling is important because it helps reduce the amount of waste we produce.

answers.answer: She does recycling every week and puts glass, paper, and plastic in different bins.
He drinks recycling every morning to stay fit and full of energy.
She cooks recycling in the kitchen for her family every Sunday lunchtime.
He drives his recycling to work every morning instead of taking the bus.
